data: Only existing BIDMC recording IDs 1..30; no additional data
budget_interpretation: Prespecified research sensitivity analysis; no clinically validated primary budget; no choosing a winner budget on outer outcomes
threshold_candidates: unique linear quantiles of current-normal outer-training OOF scores, plus nextafter(max,+inf) as no-training-alert option; include complete tied scores
objective: among candidates meeting BOTH budget and active cap, maximize training-only one-to-one event detections at 30s; ties: fewer off-event starts, less active time, highest threshold
no_event_training_rule: same ties select minimum burden/activity; do not inspect outer outcomes
fallback: candidate above maximum training score is feasible with zero training alerts; not guaranteed silent on unseen scores
scope: one scalar threshold per outer-fold/model/budget; no smoothing, suppression or new postprocessing
selection_data: only saved OOF rows with Outer_Test_Record equal to the held-out fold, and Record in outer_train_records; never full-data demo scores
exposure: audited strict current-normal valid pulse edges, <=2s, excluding intervening current-low/invalid numerics and incomplete future coverage
false_alarm: alarm episode starts without ANY qualifying observed onset in (start,start+W]; redundant starts reported separately
matching: existing chronological earliest unused episode start in [onset-W,onset); one credit per event/episode; no reset at event window edges
outer: unchanged recording-wise LOGO scores and inner three-group folds; no parameter-dependent refits needed for threshold-only experiment
bootstrap: paired unstratified whole-record multiplicities across all 30; conditional on saved fitted CV scores
limitations: cohort already inspected; thresholds on inner-refit scores may transfer poorly to outer refits; no patient independence or clinical validation
